recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No additional core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-16773 unless Vocabulary later decides to add a dedicated unmapped/use-source-code example beyond the existing notes, CodeSystem definition, and $translate examples.
issue_request: FHIR-16773 was a Published / Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue for STU3 ConceptMap. It asked to clarify the old unmapped-mode 'provided' wording because it was unclear what was provided and where, and because the text referred to a $translate operation; the resolution was to say to use the source code being translated and to improve the unmapped discussion/example material.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 14770, represented by git commit f82e3c73beeeeed5c68cbcae84004e5952ae3f01, which added ConceptMap introduction text linking to the ConceptMap $translate operation and linked the provided-mode row in the unmapped discussion to $translate. The Handling Unmapped Codes section had just been added by related commit d75acd989aa64eb9de7ae6a439abe0b3377ecfdd for FHIR-14687.
additional_context: ConceptMap is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Published decisions in the same area, especially FHIR-22100 and FHIR-32546, clarified the unmapped-mode definitions and replaced the confusing 'provided' code with 'use-source-code'; both are already represented on the combined branch. The current ConceptMap source includes OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate, request/response examples for $translate, a use-source-code unmapped-mode definition tied to sourceCode/sourceCoding/sourceCodeableConcept, and matching notes text. Confluence had no direct FHIR-16773 reference, and Zulip evidence supports the later clarification path rather than a conflicting current requirement.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current combined-branch source already conveys the material FHIR-16773 requirement after the original application and later FHIR-22100/FHIR-32546 refinements.
